# Psalm 139 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. Of-David. A-psalm. O-YHWH you-have-searched-me and-you-know.

**2** You know my-sitting and-my-rising; you-understand my-thought from-afar.

**3** My-path and-my-lying-down you-have-sifted, and-with-all my-ways you-are-familiar.

**4** For there-is-no word on-my-tongue — behold O-YHWH you-know-it all.

**5** Behind and-before you-have-enclosed-me, and-you-have-laid upon-me your-hand.

**6** Too-wonderful knowledge for-me; it-is-high, not I-am-able for-it.

**7** Where shall-I-go from-your-Spirit? And-where from-your-face shall-I-flee?

**8** If I-ascend the-heavens, there you-are; and-if I-make-my-bed in-Sheol, behold-you.

**9** If I-take wings-of the-dawn, if-I-dwell in-uttermost-of the-sea,

**10** Also there your-hand will-lead-me, and-will-hold-me your-right-hand.

**11** And-if I-say, 'Surely darkness will-cover-me, and-night light around-me,'

**12** Also darkness not is-dark to-you, and-night like-the-day gives-light; like-the-darkness like-the-light.

**13** For you created my-inward-parts; you-wove-me in-womb-of my-mother.

**14** I-will-give-thanks-to-you for awesomely I-am-wonderfully-made; wonderful your-works, and-my-soul knows very-well.

**15** Not was-hidden my-frame from-you, when I-was-made in-secret, woven in-depths-of the-earth.

**16** My-unformed-substance your-eyes saw, and-in-your-book all were-written, the-days formed, and-not one among-them.

**17** And-to-me how precious your-thoughts O-God! How vast their-sum!

**18** If-I-count-them, more-than-sand they-are-numerous; I-awake and-still I-am with-you.

**19** If you-would-slay O-God the-wicked! And-men-of blood depart from-me!

**20** Who speak-of-you for-wickedness; they-lift-up to-vanity your-adversaries.

**21** Do-not those-hating-you O-YHWH I-hate? And-with-those-rising-against-you I-loathe?

**22** With-completeness-of hatred I-hate-them; as-enemies they-are to-me.

**23** Search-me O-God and-know my-heart; test-me and-know my-anxious-thoughts.

**24** And-see if-way-of pain in-me, and-lead-me in-way everlasting.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **139:13-16**: The most detailed OT passage on divine formation of the individual in the womb — golem ('unformed-substance') in v.16 is unique in the Bible.

- **139:7-12**: The classic statement of divine omnipresence — heaven, Sheol, dawn, sea, darkness — no place escapes God's presence.

- **139:23-24**: The closing prayer inverts the opening: 'You have-searched-me' (v.1) becomes 'Search-me' (v.23) — from description to invitation.

— EMET
